verdict.rationale: Mistral documents a broad API that exposes many capabilities that also appear in its UI: agents with built-in tools (web search, document library/RAG, code interpreter, image generation), conversations, moderation rules, batching, and model catalog listing. Nothing in the pack states or demonstrates parity with the UI. The usage dashboard is described only as a UI surface, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, API access to admin, usage and workspace-cap management, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: AI agents autonomously execute tasks using LLMs, with tools, state persistence, and multi-agent collaboration via the Agents API
Document Library enhances agents with uploaded documents via Mistral Cloud's built-in RAG tool
